title: Carte de l'Arménie, Géorgie et pays voisins (1764)
summary: Jacques-Nicolas Bellin's 1764 map of Armenia, Georgia and neighbouring lands (region of the mountains of Ararat).
license_note: Library of Congress: "free to use and reuse unless a Rights Advisory statement is present" (Geography and Map Division).
